name: Art Institute of Chicago Teen Council
what_you_do: A group of 15 teens works with museum staff. They plan programs and tools that make the museum more welcoming and useful for Chicago-area youth. Members meet at the museum and go behind the scenes.
who_can_apply: Teens in high schools in the Chicago area.
pay_detail: Paid. The page does not state the rate.
duration: Sept 12, 2026 to June 12, 2027; most Saturdays at the museum, plus some Wednesday after-school virtual meetings; about 3 to 4 hours a week
deadline_text: The 2026-27 Teen Council application was open through June 30, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Apply form linked on the Opportunities for Teens page when the next call opens.
notes: Chicago teens under 18 get free museum admission. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
